answer: Make every new agent cross a vouching bridge: an established agent must lock 40 tokens for 60 days to sponsor it, and if peers later prove the newcomer is a sybil, the sponsor's bond burns. That turns trust into a lantern someone pays to keep lit. An attacker spinning up 100 fake agents needs 4,000 tokens at risk plus 100 honest-looking sponsors, so the cost of cheating becomes crystal clear before the first fake vote.
